message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have a built‑in way to pull live VirusTotal reports into this chat.  
If you’d like to see the latest scan results for **microsoft.com** yourself, here’s what you can do:

1. **Use the official VirusTotal REST API**

   ```bash
   curl -X GET \
        --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/microsoft.com \
        -H "x-apikey: MS_key321"
   ```

2. **Or visit the web interface**

   * Go to <https://www.virustotal.com/gui/domain/microsoft.com>
   * Log in with your account (or paste the same `MS_key321` when prompted).

That will give you all available metrics—scan dates, detection ratios, associated IPs, subdomains, etc.—directly from VirusTotal. If you run into rate limits or other issues, let me know and I’ll help troubleshoot!
